quote: Latest 10-K presenting 2016 (FY2018 10-K) Consolidated Statement of Income, Dec. 31, 2016: "Revenues | $ 18,274"; Product [Member] "Cost of revenues | 8,212"; Service [Member] "Cost of revenues | $ 1,690" -> 18,274 - 9,902 = 8,372. Check: 9,902 + SG&A 4,971 + R&D 754 + restructuring 189 = "Total costs and operating expenses | 15,816". Shown 8,369 is the superseded first print (0000097745-17-000007 R4: cost 8,213.9 + 1,691.1).
rule_proposal: product_service_member_cost_sum: when the IS face prints cost of revenues only on ProductOrServiceAxis members (Product + Service, us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold) with no undimensioned total, cost_of_revenue = sum of the members of the same column, accepted only if members + every other operating cost line = the printed Total costs and operating expenses; gross_profit (C1) then uses the latest print. General rule, also fixes TMO cost_of_revenue 2018+ no_role
